results.title: Odisha government enhances financial powers for Municipal Corporations, NACs
results.description: Odisha government on Tuesday revised the financial powers of seven municipal corporations and municipalities for the payment of bills. The changes cover municipal corporations, municipalities and Notified Area Councils ( NAC s), with the revised provisions coming into effect immediately. Under the new system, different office-bearers and officials have been assigned specific financial limits for clearing bills. The move revises the existing financial powers for payments by urban local bodies. New Financial Limits Municipal Corporation Commissioners can now clear bills of up to Rs 1 crore. Executive Officers (EOs) have been authorised to make payments of up to Rs 20 lakh, while the Mayor will have the power to approve payments exceeding Rs 1 crore. Amounts exceeding this limit for EOs will come under the authority of the respective chairpersons. Smart City Gets Full Payment Authority The Managing Director (MD) of Smart City has been granted full financial authority for payment of all types of bills. Also Read: Odisha government tightens Ayushman scheme norms, makes 24x7 help desks mandatory; issues warning The revised financial arrangement for municipal corporations, municipalities, NACs and Smart City will take effect immediately.

results.title: Silver Breakdown Loading !! 55 Is the Real Line in the Sand ..
results.description: Silver is still firmly bearish in my view and I see the market is building for another proper downside leg rather than preparing for a fresh breakout higher. If you zoom out, the structure after that massive vertical expansion is ugly the top was followed by violent liquidation, every meaningful recovery since then has failed to restore the previous momentum and price has spent months forming lower highs while repeatedly coming back into the same demand. That is the part I don’t like for bulls. The 58–60 zone keeps getting revisited, each reaction from it is producing less upside and the latest bounce could only push into roughly 65–67 before sellers took control again. To me that looks more like distribution and demand being absorbed than accumulation. The 70.85 region remains the major resistance above and that is the level bulls would have to reclaim on a daily basis before I even consider changing the bigger picture. Until then I’m treating upside moves as corrective rallies inside a bearish structure. The immediate battle is obviously 58–60, but I don’t think that is the most important level on this chart. 55 is the real yearly structural support. Once price starts trading below 58–60, I expect 55 to get attacked fairly quickly, and if we get a convincing daily breakdown and acceptance below 55, that would confirm to me that this entire higher-timeframe floor has failed. At that point the market loses the last major support created during the previous expansion and there is a huge amount of open space underneath. That is where I would expect downside momentum to accelerate rather than another small controlled pullback. My larger target remains the old breakout/base structure around 46.58–45.15. That area makes much more sense to me as the place where silver could finally find serious higher-timeframe demand again. So my roadmap remains 65–67 is the nearest rejection area, 70.85 is the major bearish invalidation, 58–60 is the support currently being eaten away, 55 is the level that confirms the real breakdown and 46.58–45.15 remains my final downside objective. I’m not interested in forcing a bullish story while price keeps failing to reclaim structure. My base case is still that this support eventually gives up and silver moves considerably lower. Trade safe !
